subject: Architecture
title: The Chrysler Building: Art Deco's Crown Jewel
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Chrysler Building: Art Deco's Crown Jewel.

hook.text: The Chrysler Building won the world's tallest race using a secret 125-foot spire hidden inside.

buildup.text: Its stainless steel crown catches sunlight like a zigzag crown of silver and glass.

discovery.text: The eagle gargoyles at the 61st floor are modeled after Chrysler car hood ornaments.

twist.text: It was the world's tallest for only 11 months before the Empire State Building surpassed it.

climax.text: Architects consistently vote it New York's most beautiful building — not tallest, but best loved.

punchline.text: It lost the height war but won the beauty contest forever.

quiz.question: How did the Chrysler Building briefly claim the world's tallest title?
options: It added extra floors during construction
A secret spire was assembled inside and raised at the last moment
Its competitor's construction was delayed by a strike
